template:
Hi ,
Thank you for reaching out, and we’re very sorry for the inconvenience.
iWeaver was recently updated, and the new version uses a different data storage and permission management structure. To protect user data security and prevent old channels from being incorrectly linked to another account, old channels cannot be automatically brought into the new iWeaver dashboard at this time.
Your old channels have not been deleted. You can continue to access them through the “old iWeaver” entry at the bottom of the left sidebar. From there, you can review your previous channels and manually copy or organize any important content into the new iWeaver dashboard if needed.
We understand this may create extra work for you, and we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. Thank you for your patience and understanding.
Best regards,
iWeaver Team

scenario: 用户咨询chat记录消失的问题
template:
Hi,
We’re very sorry for the inconvenience, and thank you for your patience and understanding.
We recently upgraded our server and Chat system. The new version uses a different data storage and permission management structure. To protect user data security, account permissions, and prevent historical conversations from being incorrectly linked to another account, old chat records cannot be automatically synced into the new Chat at this time.
Please rest assured that your previous chat history has not been simply deleted. We will provide an access point for the old version of Chat history, which is expected to become available within the next 2–3 days. Once it is available, you can find it at the bottom of the left sidebar. You’ll be able to review your previous conversations there and manually copy or organize any important content into the new Chat if needed.
We sincerely apologize again for the inconvenience and truly appreciate your understanding.
Best regards,
iWeaver Team

template:
Dear Customer,

Thank you for reaching out to us.

We are happy to assist you with the invoice for your subscription. In order to issue the invoice correctly, we kindly request you to provide the following details:

1. Company Name
2. VAT Number
3. Address
4. Email Address used for the iweaver subscription

Once we receive the information, we will process the invoice promptly. If you have any questions or need further assistance, please don’t hesitate to let us know.

Thank you for your cooperation and support.

Best regards,  
  
iWeaver Team

Sehr geehrte Kundin, sehr geehrter Kunde,

vielen Dank für Ihre Nachricht.

Gerne unterstützen wir Sie bei der Rechnung für Ihr Abonnement. Damit wir die Rechnung korrekt ausstellen können, senden Sie uns bitte die folgenden Informationen:

1. Firmenname
2. Umsatzsteuer-/Steuernummer
3. Adresse
4. E-Mail-Adresse, die für das iWeaver-Abonnement verwendet wurde

Sobald wir diese Informationen erhalten, bearbeiten wir die Rechnung. Bei weiteren Fragen helfen wir Ihnen gerne weiter.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
iWeaver Team
